python3 - <<'EOF'
from boltons.iterutils import get_path, PathAccessError

# doctest example
root = {'a': {'b': {'c': [[1], [2], [3]]}}}
assert get_path(root, ('a', 'b', 'c', 2, 0)) == 3
# dotted list-index path (string segments coerced for lists)
assert get_path({'key': ['test']}, 'key.0') == 'test'
assert get_path({'key': [{'x': 'deep'}]}, 'key.0.x') == 'deep'
# tuple path
assert get_path({'a': {'b': 7}}, ('a', 'b')) == 7
assert get_path(['test'], (0,)) == 'test'
assert get_path(['test'], '0') == 'test'
assert get_path({'key': 'value'}, ('key',)) == 'value'
# string indexing still works like upstream
assert get_path({'a': 'bcd'}, ('a', 1)) == 'c'
# defaults on failure at any level
assert get_path({'a': {'b': 7}}, ('a', 'z'), default=None) is None
assert get_path({'a': {'b': 7}}, ('z',), default='dflt') == 'dflt'
assert get_path([], (3,), default='dflt') == 'dflt'
assert get_path({'a': 5}, ('a', 'b'), default='dflt') == 'dflt'
# PathAccessError details
try:
    get_path({'a': {'b': 7}}, ('a', 'zzz'))
except PathAccessError as pae:
    assert isinstance(pae, (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError))
    assert pae.seg == 'zzz'
    assert pae.path == ('a', 'zzz')
    assert isinstance(pae.exc, KeyError)
    assert repr(pae) == "PathAccessError(KeyError('zzz'), 'zzz', ('a', 'zzz'))"
    assert 'zzz' in str(pae)
else:
    raise AssertionError('expected PathAccessError')
# out-of-range on nested list reports the right seg/path
try:
    get_path({'a': {'b': [1]}}, ('a', 'b', 5))
except PathAccessError as pae:
    assert pae.seg == 5 and pae.path == ('a', 'b', 5)
    assert isinstance(pae.exc, IndexError)
else:
    raise AssertionError('expected PathAccessError')
# non-indexable parent produces TypeError message
try:
    get_path({'a': 5}, ('a', 'b'))
except PathAccessError as pae:
    assert pae.seg == 'b'
    assert 'not indexable' in str(pae)
else:
    raise AssertionError('expected PathAccessError')
# no exception leaks when default provided mid-path
print('all behavior checks OK')
EOF
